title: Reader
author: @lunokjod
description: A book of the disk, read a page at a time: the shelf of every `.epub` of the flash and the card, the page composed by the system with the serif face of the book, the foot with the chapter and how far in you are, and the position of each book kept as the chapter and the byte. Two buttons turn the page and the rest is silence, which is what a reader is.
